reader.requirement: At --std 85 executing a PERFORM must transfer once to the first statement of the specified set and return after the last statement of procedure-name-1 (paragraph), of its last paragraph (section), of procedure-name-2 (paragraph) or of procedure-name-2's last paragraph (section), or after the last contained statement (in-line); a GO TO as that last statement transfers away.

edition-consulted.switches: segment last-used flag and DEBUG-CONTENTS 'PERFORM LOOP' only when the unit has independent segments / USE FOR DEBUGGING

reader.edition-search: The return point is the bounded dispatch over the range's end pc; no edition comparison on that path (grepped ControlFlowEmitter.cs for Edition|CobolVersion: none).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb440 covers the empty set (no transfer); GR7a-d return points with GO TO inside the range are not in the listed witnesses

probes.printed: PA PC PB RET1 (7c after GO TO out and back) / S2-A S2-C RET2 (7b) / PA PB PC S2-A S2-C RET3 (7d) / S2-A S2-C S3 END (PERFORM S2 THRU S2-A whose last statement GO TO S2-C transfers away; RET4 not printed)
probes.expected: return after the last statement of the named end; a GO TO executed as that last statement leaves the range

probes.printed: 7a PERFORM PA returns before PB; 7e nested in-line IN IN OUT twice
PA PC PB S2-A S2-C S3 END (PB's last statement GO TO PEND)
probes.expected: no return: control leaves the range by the GO TO

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.21.4 GR7  (6.21.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7

reader.notes: The out-of-line PERFORM is a bounded dispatch that returns when the end pc completes, so a GO TO ending the range leaves it and a GO TO back in still returns. A first draft of g7b looped by design (PC GO TO PB, PB falls into PC); I stopped it, and it was a fault of the probe, not of the compiler.
reader.at-2023: p1 identical; g7b not re-run at 2023 (same emitter, no edition switch)

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-017/p3.cbl at --std 85, identical at --std 2023 apart from COBOL0903 warnings. A NEXT SENTENCE executed in the last sentence of a performed paragraph PA returns to the PERFORM (RET T=+001, without falling into PB). The ELSE arm returns as well (RET2). PERFORM SX, a section whose last paragraph is empty, returns after SX-1 (RET3). PERFORM PA THRU PB, where PB's last sentence is IF ... NEXT SENTENCE, returns (RET4). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.21.4 GR7  (6.21.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7'.
